title: The Potential Anti-psoriatic Effects of Andrographolide: A Comparative Study to Topical Corticosteroids.
authors: Dharmasamitha, Indira; Mas Rusyati, Luh Made; Wati, Dyah Kanya; Gelgel Wirasuta, I Made Agus
journal: Recent advances in inflammation & allergy drug discovery
one_liner_zh: 该文研究穿心莲内酯抗银屑病作用，涉及分子对接但对象为NF-kB等炎症蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Andrographolide (AP), a bioactive anti-inflammatory compound of Sambiloto, inhibits NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and interleukin IL-6. Nowadays, molecular docking simulation between AP and dexamethasone against NF-kappaB receptor presented the energy AP higher than dexamethasone. This becomes a potential treatment for psoriasis. OBJECTIVE: This manuscript reported the effectiveness of AP from Sambiloto in treating psoriasis compared to topical steroids. METHODS: This study conducted TLC analysis of AP content and its metabolite impurities, emulgel formulation, molecular docking, in-silico skin toxicity study, and in-vivo anti-psoriatic activity. This was a combination study of an in-silico study and an in-vivo study. This in-silico study was analyzed through multivariate statistical analysis (PCA) to elucidate the data constellation relationship of andrographolide derivatives with several target proteins. The intervention was performed in seven days. The PASI score, molecular parameters (IL-6, IL-17, VEGF, and TNF-a levels), and histopathological findings were assessed. RESULTS: Molecular docking results revealed andrographolide to exhibit a relatively high binding affinity towards IL-6, NF-kB, and TNF-alpha which is comparable to the corticosteroids, andrographolide also shares similar residue interaction profile with each of the respective protein's native ligand. In the in-vivo study, we found several parameters statistically significantly different regarding the intervention, including final PASI score (p = 0.017), redness (p = 0.017), scale (p = 0.040), thickness (p = 0.023), total histopathology of psoriasis score (p = 0.037), keratin layer score (p = 0.018). CONCLUSION: Emulgel AP 0.1% could lower the anti-inflammatory agent, which is vital to psoriasis progression.
abstract_zh: 背景：穿心莲内酯（Andrographolide, AP）是Sambiloto的一种生物活性抗炎化合物，可抑制NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha和白细胞介素IL-6。目前，AP与地塞米松（dexamethasone）对NF-kappaB受体的分子对接模拟显示，AP的能量高于地塞米松。这使其成为银屑病的潜在治疗方法。目的：本手稿报告了Sambiloto中AP在治疗银屑病方面与局部类固醇相比的有效性。方法：本研究进行了AP含量及其代谢杂质的TLC分析、乳膏剂（emulgel）配方、分子对接、计算机模拟皮肤毒性研究以及体内抗银屑病活性。这是计算机模拟研究与体内研究的结合研究。计算机模拟研究通过多变量统计分析（PCA）进行分析，以阐明穿心莲内酯衍生物与多种靶蛋白之间的数据构象关系。干预持续七天。评估了PASI评分、分子参数（IL-6、IL-17、VEGF和TNF-a水平）以及组织病理学发现。结果：分子对接结果显示，穿心莲内酯对IL-6、NF-kB和TNF-alpha表现出相对较高的结合亲和力，与皮质类固醇相当，且穿心莲内酯与每种蛋白的天然配体共享相似的残基相互作用谱。在体内研究中，我们发现了几个在干预方面具有统计学显著差异的参数，包括最终PASI评分（p = 0.017）、发红（p = 0.017）、鳞屑（p = 0.040）、厚度（p = 0.023）、银屑病总组织病理学评分（p = 0.037）、角质层评分（p = 0.018）。结论：0.1% AP乳膏剂可降低抗炎因子，这对银屑病进展至关重要。
